issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal): The problem statement's UML and text specify that calculateTotalPrice should return a double (double precision is explicitly requested in the description), but the implementation in the solution repository declares calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This mismatch between the specified return type (double) and the implemented return type (int) can confuse students about the expected method signature and numeric precision and may lead to failing checks if tests or graders expect a double return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method signature of SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to return double in the implementation and adjust the implementation to accumulate and return a double (e.g., double sum = 0.0; add ingredient prices as doubles). Also update any template, solution, and tests (or call sites) to expect a double return type so the specification, template, and reference implementation are consistent. Ensure method declaration line in SealSaloon.java is updated accordingly.
